units.source_text: 藏人少将看了信，想道：“原来别人如此悠闲，诉恨也是斯文一脉的。

en.t: After reading the letter, the Chamberlain Lieutenant thought, "So others can be this composed, and even voice resentment with such refinement.
I am far too impatient, and I have made myself laughable.

units.source_text: 她们瞧我不起，恐怕一半是看惯了我这种习气之故。”

en.t: If they look down on me, it is probably partly because they are so used to this habit of mine."

units.source_text: 他胸中苦闷，并不和藤侍从多谈，准备到一向常与商量的侍女中将房中去和她谈谈，但念去谈也是枉然，因此只管唉声叹气。

en.t: His heart was troubled, and he did not say much to Fuji no Jiju. He thought of going to the room of Chujo, the gentlewoman with whom he usually consulted, to talk things over, but then decided that even that would be useless, and so he could only keep sighing.

units.source_text: 藤侍从说：“我要写回信给他呢。”

en.t: Fuji no Jiju said, "I must write him a reply."

units.source_text: 便拿了信去和母亲商量了。

en.t: She then took the letter and went to consult her mother.

units.source_text: 藏人少将睹此情状，大为不快，甚至生起气来。

en.t: Seeing this, the Chamberlain Lieutenant became deeply displeased and even grew angry.

units.source_text: 可见年轻人的心思是专一不化的。

en.t: This shows how single-minded and unyielding young people can be.
